aboutSection.title: About MCS Limo
aboutSection.p1: MCS Limo is a passenger transport company offering a tailor-made and top-of-the-range service by providing its customers with professional private drivers with luxury cars.
aboutSection.p2: MCS Limo is present in France as well as in the largest cities around the world (Berlin, Frankfurt, Madrid, Barcelona, New York, Washington, Miami, Tokyo, Sydney…) to accompany its business and private customers during their travels to offer them the same standard of quality wherever they travel.

about.title: About us
about.subtitle: Excellence in private chauffeur services in Paris and around the world
about.p1: MCS Limo is a passenger transport company offering a tailor-made and top-of-the-range service by providing its customers with professional private drivers with luxury cars.
about.p2: MCS Limo is present in France as well as in the largest cities around the world (Berlin, Frankfurt, Madrid, Barcelona, New York, Washington, Miami, Tokyo, Sydney…) to accompany its business and private customers during their travels.
about.pageSubtitle: To make you discover who MCS Limo is
about.missionP1: MCS Limo was created with the sole aim of offering its customers a high-end transport experience to a demanding clientele.
about.missionP2: We work every day to satisfy an ever-increasing demand in the field of transport in luxury cars with driver, offering our customers a unique experience from the first contact to the agreed drop-off location, and beyond. Indeed, we are attentive to our customers in order to make our services better, day by day.
about.qualityP1: At MCS Limo, every detail counts. Our vehicles are meticulously chosen and maintained. And our drivers are chosen for their experience and sense of service.
about.qualityP2: Luxury, comfort, courtesy, discretion and sense of service are the key words that will inevitably accompany you during each of your bookings.
about.presenceTitle: We are present throughout France, and beyond!
about.presenceP1: MCS Limo is based in Paris, but takes care of meeting the needs of its customers throughout France, and everywhere else: London, Berlin, Rome, Brussels, New York, Tokyo, etc.
about.presenceP2: Wherever you are, we will be there to accompany you and present you with the offer adapted to your need.

yearlyChauffeur.title: Yearly driver
yearlyChauffeur.subtitle: A tailor-made solution for executives, families and companies looking for a dedicated full-time or part-time driver.
yearlyChauffeur.p1: Benefit from a dedicated high-end driver trained in discretion, secure driving, and protocol management.
yearlyChauffeur.quoteBtn: Get a quote for a year-round chauffeur
yearlyChauffeur.sec1Heading: A single contract, and a dedicated chauffeur at your disposal year-round.
yearlyChauffeur.sec1Text: No more last-minute bookings or unpredictable ride-hailing services. With MCS Limo's Year-Round Chauffeur plan, your vehicle and personal chauffeur are available whenever you need them, Monday through Friday and even on weekends. Enjoy a truly tailor-made service perfectly aligned with your professional and private lifestyle.
yearlyChauffeur.sec1Point1: Your chauffeur awaits you every day, without requiring repeated bookings
yearlyChauffeur.sec1Point2: Daily availability Monday to Friday, and weekends as needed
yearlyChauffeur.sec2Text: Having your own private chauffeur year-round is more accessible than you think. With clear, predictable pricing, you master your transportation budget while enjoying top-tier luxury: latest vehicle models, experienced and attentive chauffeurs, and flawless service on every trip.
yearlyChauffeur.sec2Point1: Clear and advantageous pricing, free of on-demand surge costs
yearlyChauffeur.sec2Point2: Meticulously maintained luxury fleet (Mercedes E-Class, S-Class, V-Class)
yearlyChauffeur.sec2Point3: Guaranteed discretion, courtesy, and continuous service — two dedicated drivers in rotation for flawless availability

cgv.title: Terms & Conditions
cgv.intro: These general terms and conditions of sale govern the passenger transportation services provided by MCars Services (MCS Limo), registered with the Paris Trade and Companies Register under number 852 506 948, and registered on the official register of passenger car operators with driver (VTC).
cgv.sec1Text: Bookings can be made online via our website, by email at contact@mcslimo.fr, or by phone at +33 1 89 48 02 96. A reservation becomes definitive upon written confirmation issued by MCS Limo.
cgv.sec2Text: Our rates include vehicle rental with a private chauffeur, passenger insurance, fuel, toll charges, and VAT at prevailing rates. Payment is accepted via major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), bank transfer, or corporate billing.
cgv.sec3Text: Passengers must wear seat belts in accordance with French road regulations. All vehicles are strictly non-smoking. Complimentary Wi-Fi, refreshments, and child seats are available upon request.
cgv.sec4Text: Cancellations made at least 24 hours prior to the scheduled pickup time are free of charge. For cancellations made less than 24 hours in advance or in the event of a client no-show, the full rate or standby fee may apply.
cgv.sec5Text: These terms and conditions are governed by and construed in accordance with French law.

privacy.title: Privacy & Cookie Policy
privacy.cookiesText: A cookie is a small file stored on your device when browsing our website. It allows us to remember your preferences (such as selected language), analyze site traffic, and optimize your browsing experience.
privacy.browserText: You can configure your browser to accept or reject cookies systematically or depending on their origin.
privacy.dataText: The information collected is processed electronically to manage your bookings and contact inquiries. Your data is never sold or shared with unauthorized third parties.
privacy.rightsText: You may access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time. For any inquiries, please contact contact@mcslimo.fr.
